card.fact_statement: Human Rights Watch conducted an investigation that led to the official announcement of the Catatumbo campaign in August 2019.
card.source_span: The existence of the campaign was officially announced in August 2019 after a Human Rights Watch (HRW) investigation.

target_qa_variants.question: หน่วยงานตรวจสอบใดที่ดำเนินการสืบสวนจนนำไปสู่การประกาศอย่างเป็นทางการของแคมเปญ Catatumbo ในเดือนสิงหาคม 2019?
target_qa_variants.expected_answer: ฮิวแมนไรต์วอตช์
target_qa_variants.source_span: The existence of the campaign was officially announced in August 2019 after a Human Rights Watch (HRW) investigation.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'Human Rights Watch' using its established Thai transliteration (ฮิวแมนไรต์วอตช์). 'Catatumbo campaign' is translated as 'แคมเปญ Catatumbo' to maintain the literal meaning of campaign while keeping the proper noun.

backtranslation_en.question: Which investigative agency conducted the investigation that led to the official announcement of the Catatumbo campaign in August 2019?
